content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using the comparator value "Ax-Ay", but no value is displayed during the online test, as shown in the attached file. However, in simulation, everything works as expected. Is there a way to resolve this? Thank you.
During the online test, values in the expanded fields under the block do not update—they only update in simulation mode.
Alright, thanks. If the values aren't visible in the online test, I hope the actual processing still works correctly.

analysis.insight_summary: A user indicates that the "Ax-Ay" analog comparator does not show values in the online test, though it works in simulation. Another user adds that only the simulation updates expanded block fields. There is concern about whether processing functions properly when values are not visibly refreshed online.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the comparator value to be displayed and consistently updated in real time during the online test, similar to the simulation, to enable effective monitoring and verification.
